name: 04-bad-tolz-family
seed_text: We hiked in Bad Tölz. The weather was amazing. We arrived to the parking spot around 12. Went to the city centre and enjoyed some brunch. Everyone loved little Danny. After that we started our trip along the river Isar. Danny and us enjoyed the hike a lot. At the end we visited an old church with very strange figures of Jesus and his friends. It was creepy and those wax figures were waiting for us in unexpected places. Then we grabbed some Asian food to go and enjoyed our dinner near the water. It was four of us: Katya, Olga, Igor and little Danny.
